full_details: It was the fourth fierce night, with oil of cloves and wool in the cheek, and you slept little. At first light you tried the Friar's cell. Every character on the sheet had gone irritable, the Friar most of all. You struck eleven lines and kept none. At nine Richard Cowley came as far as the foot of the stair, which was as far as Mistress Ansell allowed, with today's part already learned. You began on the reason for the second cut. He said a reason would not help an entrance. You settled it roll against roll, and you stayed in. You ate what she called broth and you called water. At half past six you spoke to Gilbert from the lodging. The money had gone down safe by the carrier of the second. A cheese of your mother's make was with him, half of it yours, and he meant to eat your half. The August frame was thatched. You told him the tooth comes out tomorrow at ten, at twelve pence. He would have done it for six with the shop pliers. Afterward you wrote one line in the almanac against tomorrow.
one_sentence: You struck eleven lines at first light, settled today's part at the foot of the stair, and gave Gilbert joy of his day.
title: Struck eleven lines, and gave Gilbert joy of his day
